name: Izayoi no Hanayome
source:
Two people on the full night perform a "ritual". None of them knows how to do it. Boy suddenly has an urge to suck girl's blood, and she gets unconscious. Her heartbeat weakens, skin becomes pale, and she stops to respond anymore.
Main character who comes from the family of vampires needs to find a new, more suitable bride candidate. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两人在月圆之夜举行了一场“仪式”，却没有任何一人知道正确做法。少年突然涌起吸食女孩鲜血的冲动，女孩随即失去意识。她的心跳逐渐微弱，皮肤变得苍白，再也没有任何反应。
出身吸血鬼家族的主人公必须寻找一名更为合适的新娘候选人。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
